subject: Renewal: APAC on-prem branch uplift & term coordination
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: APAC on-prem branch uplift & term coordination

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, MedAlign is looking to: (1) add two isolated on-prem clusters in APAC for regional preprocessing (edge nodes), (2) keep a private VPC footprint for PHI workloads, and (3) align renewal terms so you can secure pricing and capacity.

Quick summary of asks we covered:
- 2 x APAC on-prem clusters (N+1 for availability) with dedicated KV cache waiver
- Data residency: APAC clusters will handle tokenization and KV cache only; PHI inference remains in your private VPC (no cross-region KV replication)
- Term: you recommended a 24->36 month commit in exchange for a 12% effective unit discount
- Security: SOC 2 evidence + KMS integration required prior to cutover

I've attached a preliminary capacity_estimate_apac.xlsx with sizing assumptions. Internal team (cc'd) — can you validate the node types and the proposed burst policy (we suggested 20% burst headroom)?

Next steps I suggest:
1) Redwood scope + SOW amendment draft (we'll produce a redline)
2) Procurement review for the 36-month pricing and PO cadence
3) Security handoff for SOC 2/KMS checklist before provisioning

Sarah — can you confirm procurement contact and preferred contract lead time for DocuSign once we send the amendment?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: capacity_estimate_apac.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets: sizing | traffic-profile | cost-model)
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@medalign.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medalign.com>, Dan Cho <dan.cho@medalign.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: APAC on-prem branch uplift & term coordination

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the detailed summary. Confirming MedAlign is keen to proceed with the two APAC clusters; procurement looped in here. A few clarifications from our side:
- We need the APAC clusters to be air-gapped from any non-APAC public endpoints until we finish the compliance review (will need an exception window for code deploys).
- Can you confirm whether Redwood provides a managed KMS bridge for customer HSMs, or do we run our own local KMS and integrate?
- The 36-month term looks reasonable if the discount is applied as you outlined — procurement will need line-item pricing and an SOW showing staged milestones.

Procurement (procurement@medalign.com): our preferred timeline is a two-week review once Kimberly sends the amendment. Dan will be the contract owner on our side.

Regards,
Sarah Lim
VP Product Operations | MedAlign
>sarah.lim@medalign.com
+65 6123 8890
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@medalign.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: APAC on-prem branch uplift & term coordination

Thanks Sarah — noted on the air-gap requirement and timeline. Quick answers from our side:
- KMS: Redwood supports both options. We can provide a managed key-bridge service that proxies encryption keys to customer KMS/HSM, or you can host a local KMS and we’ll configure the integration. For regulated PHI workloads we recommend customer-hosted KMS for audit traceability; we'll include both options in the SOW.
- Air-gap: we can implement a temporary maintenance window for deploys; our ops team will provide a vetted plan.

Karthik/Priyom — please see Sarah's ask and the attached sizing. Action items:
- Karthik: confirm exact node SKU and verify that the proposed burst headroom is feasible given APAC capacity constraints.
- Priyom: draft amendment SOW with staged milestones (design sign-off -> compliance validation -> cutover) and two pricing rows: 24-month and 36-month committed term. Include the managed KMS bridge as an optional add-on.

Procurement — once the SOW is ready, I will send the DocuSign link and a summary redline (we will try to keep the core terms unchanged; the amendment is for scope + term/price).

Thanks,
Kimberly

Attachment: draft_amendment_sow.pdf (stub — to be replaced by Priyom's draft)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@medalign.com>, Procurement <procurement@medalign.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: APAC on-prem branch uplift & term coordination

Kimberly — reviewed the sizing and APAC capacity with infra ops. Notes:
- Node SKU: 2 x rinf-24g (GPU-optimized inference nodes) per cluster looks correct based on the traffic profile. We'll reserve an additional cold standby node (N+1).
- Burst policy: 20% burst headroom is feasible but will require a reserved burst pool. If MedAlign signs a 36-month commitment we can reserve the burst pool up-front to guarantee SLA and lower the burst unit price by ~18%.
- Air-gap deploys: ops requested a 3-week window for the first cutover to run compliance checks and smoke tests.

I attached a brief SOC 2 evidence summary (SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf) that outlines which artifacts we'll need during the security handoff. Priyom — please incorporate Karthik's pricing delta (36-month vs 24-month) and the burst-reserve option into the SOW.

Procurement / Sarah: if this aligns, Kimberly will send a redline and DocuSign link by end of week. We should be able to start provisioning once the amendment is fully executed and the security checklist is completed.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: soc2-evidence-summary.pdf (artifact checklist for security handoff)
